title: Anthropic Prompt caching
finding: Write 1.25x (5m)/2x (1h); read 0.1x, but 0.05x on Opus 5.5/Sonnet 5.5 and 0.025x on Fable 5.1/Mythos 5.1; TTL 5 min refreshed free on use; min 512-4096 tok by model; changing tool defs invalidates tools+system+messages; usage fields cache_creation_input_tokens/cache_read_input_tokens with 5m/1h split
applicability: Defines r for Anthropic and why tool-set changes are costly
limitation: Doc not measurement; later 64k chars not read

title: Anthropic Tool use with prompt caching
finding: Deferred tools are not in the system-prompt prefix; discovered ones appended inline as tool_reference so prefix cache is preserved; modifying tool defs invalidates everything; tool_choice change invalidates messages cache
applicability: Server-side exposure control that keeps cache

title: Anthropic Tool search tool
finding: Every tool definition is still sent in the tools array on every request; deferred ones are excluded from model context; search is not metered separately; loaded definitions bill as normal input; extra turns; recommended when >=10 tools or >10k tokens; Claude accuracy 'degrades beyond 30-50 tools' (vendor claim)
applicability: Direct competitor/analogue of a tool-exposure policy; client route still ships the bytes
limitation: Accuracy claim unsourced on this page

title: Anthropic Advanced tool use
finding: Tool search: Opus 4 49->74%, Opus 4.5 79.5->88.1% MCP eval; ~77K -> ~8.7K context tokens; says it does not break caching
applicability: Accuracy with fewer tools shown; token numbers not bill
limitation: Internal, no methodology; token counts not billed cost

title: Anthropic Context editing
finding: clear_tool_uses invalidates cached prefix; you pay cache writes each time; clear_at_least param to make it worthwhile; thinking-block clearing also breaks cache
applicability: Token-pruning vs bill trade-off

title: Anthropic Managed Agents overview
finding: Harness has 'built-in prompt caching, compaction'; stateful sessions; beta; tool search not available in Managed Agents; no billing detail on this page
applicability: Not a flat re-read-free price (no evidence of one)

title: Anthropic Pricing page
finding: Fable 5.1 $10 in/$12.50 5m write/$20 1h write/$0.25 read/$50 out; Fable 5 read $1 (0.1x)
applicability: r trend evidence
limitation: Opus/Sonnet 5.5 rows and batch/managed rows not seen; 0.05x from S01 footnote

title: OpenAI Prompt caching guide
finding: Caching on by default; prefix includes tool definitions; GPT-5.6+: explicit/implicit modes, TTL 30m/12h, write 1.25x/2.5x, read 0.1x (0.05x for GPT-6.1 Sol/Terra); earlier models no write fee, in_memory 5-10 min or 24h; cached_tokens and cache_write_tokens fields; routing overflow >15 rpm; earlier models report cached tokens rounded to multiple of 128; allowed_tools keeps definitions stable
applicability: Defines OpenAI route; write fee and TTL now material on 5.6+

title: OpenAI Pricing
finding: gpt-5-mini $0.25/$0.025 cached (0.1x); gpt-5.6 sol/terra/luna 0.1x with write 1.25x/2.5x; gpt-6.1-sol 0.05x; batch/flex halve input AND cached input (ratio unchanged); fast raises both; web search $10/1k calls
applicability: Ratio r stays 0.1 across tiers; batch does not alter r

title: OpenAI Tool search guide
finding: tool_search with defer_loading; designed to preserve cache; loaded tools appended at end; changing loaded set breaks cache from that point; gpt-5.4+ only; no quantified savings; billing of search step not described
applicability: Server route for exposure control

title: OpenAI Function calling (allowed_tools)
finding: allowed_tools restricts callable tools without changing list, 'to maximize savings from prompt caching'; definitions are billed as input tokens
applicability: Matches the study's D-01 server route
limitation: Whether excluded tools are billed not stated (they are in the prefix so billed as cached)

title: OpenRouter Prompt caching guide
finding: Per-provider ratios: OpenAI read 0.25-0.5x (stale vs S08), Grok 0.25, Moonshot 0.25, Groq 0.5, Qwen 0.1 w/ write 1.25, Anthropic 0.1, DeepSeek 0.1, Z.AI ~0.2, Gemini 0.25; sticky routing (60 min, session_id); usage fields cached_tokens, cache_write_tokens, cache_discount
applicability: Routing and verification route
limitation: OpenAI row lags OpenAI's own page; gives list-price multipliers

title: OpenRouter Provider selection
finding: Default routing is price/throughput/reliability weighted random; manual order/sort bypass default routing; sticky routing only in default routing
applicability: Pinning to one provider (as the study did) bypasses stickiness; stability then relies on one endpoint

title: OpenRouter /models/z-ai/glm-5.3/endpoints API
finding: 45 endpoints; cache-read/prompt ratio ranges 0.10 (BaseTen, Mistral) to ~1.0 (Relace, AkashML, Wafer); GMICloud fp8 0.186; most 0.186; only Bedrock lists a cache-write price
applicability: Strongest evidence that r varies by endpoint, not just by model

title: OpenRouter /models/minimax/minimax-m3/endpoints API
finding: 11 endpoints; ratio 0.167-0.217, mostly 0.200; no cache-write field
applicability: Confirms r~0.2 for MiniMax

title: Gemini caching doc
finding: Implicit caching default for 2.5+; usage.total_cached_tokens; min 2,048-4,096; discount, TTL, storage fee not stated on page
applicability: Gemini route
limitation: Prices absent; third-party search results (not graded) say read ~0.1x-0.25x, storage $4.50/MTok/h

title: DeepSeek KV cache guide
finding: Automatic disk cache; fields prompt_cache_hit_tokens/miss_tokens; 'best-effort', no guaranteed hit rate; expires hours-days
applicability: Reporting is split into hit/miss fields
limitation: Price ratio not on page (0.1x per OpenRouter table S12)

title: Z.ai context caching
finding: Implicit; hits 'usually 50% of standard price' on this page vs ~0.2 at GMICloud on OpenRouter; cached_tokens field; no storage fee
applicability: GLM direct vs hosted spread
limitation: Page says 50% yet OpenRouter lists ~0.2 for Z.AI endpoint = 0.186: inconsistency within official materials

title: Alibaba Model Studio context cache
finding: Explicit: write 1.25x, hit 0.1x, 5 min; implicit: write 1.0x, hit 0.2x, not guaranteed; tool definitions cannot be cached independently (counted as system message)
applicability: Qwen route

title: xAI Models page
limitation: Caching mechanism not described on page

title: Moonshot Kimi pricing doc
finding: Automatic caching, 5-min default TTL; batch 60% of price; cache-write terms unclear
applicability: Kimi route

title: Lessons from building Claude Code: prompt caching is everything
finding: Anthropic alerts on cache hit rate and declares SEVs; adding/removing a tool invalidates the cache for the whole conversation; keeps all tools in request (plan mode as tools) ; uses defer_loading stubs in stable order; compaction must share parent prefix or full input billed uncached
applicability: Strongest practitioner statement that tool-set stability is a first-order design constraint
limitation: Vendor; no quantified hit rate or savings

title: Manus: Context engineering lessons
finding: KV-hit rate 'single most important metric'; input:output ~100:1; avoid dynamically adding/removing tools; mask logits instead
applicability: Supports fixed-prefix + constrain, aligned with allowed_tools

title: Weinberger and Hozez, Token Reduction Is Not Cost Reduction
finding: 38.4% fewer tool-output tokens raised billed cost 6.8%; r=0.15 between token and cost reduction; cache creation+reads dominate input side; judge by cost per successful task
applicability: Directly supports the thesis's bill-not-tokens metric and success adjustment
limitation: Claude Code only; abstract read; composition numbers via secondary blog

title: Liu et al., Agentic Coding in the Wild (Copilot traces)
finding: 13M sessions; KV hit ~90% within a turn, ~55% across turn boundaries; model switches/compaction invalidate reuse; idle minutes
applicability: TTL/idle expiry is material across user turns, not within one ReAct episode
limitation: GitHub Copilot serving, not API billing; hit rate is server KV not billing

title: Lumer et al., Don't Break the Cache
finding: 500+ sessions on DeepResearch Bench with 10k-token system prompts, OpenAI/Anthropic/Google: caching cuts API cost 41-80%, TTFT 13-31%; dynamic function calling and dynamic tool results hurt; benefit scales linearly beyond minimum
applicability: Cross-provider measured size of cache saving; warns against dynamic tool lists
limitation: Web-search tasks; 3-50 tool calls; not exposure policy

title: Daniel Vaughan blog 'Token reduction is not cost reduction'
finding: Summarises S24/S25: bill composition cache writes 44.3% reads 35.4% output 10.4%; system prompt + tool definitions ~94% of input cost attribution; compaction destroys 66% of cache hits
applicability: Pointer to paper details to verify
limitation: Secondary; author mixes own arithmetic with study; unverified against paper

title: Vaughan blog 'Don't break the cache'
finding: Restates S26

title: Dev.to commentary on Anthropic April 23 postmortem
finding: Claims a Claude Code bug cleared thinking history every turn rather than once after idle, rebuilding context and depleting usage faster; no hit-rate numbers
applicability: Example of cache-invalidation bug in a production harness

title: vLLM AgentX / Mooncake blogs (via search snippets)
finding: Agent traces: prefix-cache hit >96% (median 43 turns); GPU-only prefix cache hit 1.7% on 610 Codex traces vs 92.2% with shared KV store; hit collapses to ~0 when workload overflows GPU cache
applicability: Free university vLLM server may have low hit rates under load

title: Community cost-breakdown posts (tokenscope, DEV 187 sessions)
finding: One Claude Code session: cache read 66% of cost, write 20%; another: ~97% of tokens are cache reads
applicability: Same order as the study's ~66%

title: GLM coding plan docs / aggregator comparisons
finding: Subscription quota counts cached input tokens with their own multiplier; MiniMax quota by prompts (~15 requests per prompt, aggregator claim)
applicability: Subscriptions are metered, not re-read-free

title: OpenRouter sticky-routing blog
finding: Stickiness only when cache-read cheaper than input; default session key hash changes when agents change first messages; worked example arithmetic not measurement
applicability: Run harness should set session_id
